7. Keep up with SEO News

Staying on top of SEO news is essential in a constantly shifting search landscape. From Google’s core updates and new SERP features to changes in ranking systems across search engines, even small updates can have a big impact on visibility and performance.

This page curates the most trusted sources for SEO news—including search news publications, SEO newsletters, podcasts, and aggregators—so you can keep up without the noise. Whether you prefer quick headlines or deep analysis, there’s a format here that fits your workflow.

Each resource is carefully selected for its credibility, consistency, and depth of coverage, helping you stay ahead of algorithm changes and make confident, well-informed decisions for your SEO strategy.

Frequently Asked Questions About SEO News

Search engines like Google release algorithm updates frequently— usually several times per year. While some updates are minor and happen almost daily, major updates (such as Google’s core updates) typically roll out every few months. These larger updates can significantly impact search rankings and are usually announced through official channels like the Google Search Central Blog.

  • Follow official sources: Monitor Google Search Central LinkedIn profile, and Google Search Liaison in X.

  • Subscribe to SEO newsletters: Get curated updates from sources like SEOFOMO or Search Engine Roundtable.

  • Use SEO news aggregators: Like SEOFOMO News, where SEO news are submitted, upvoted and commented by community members.

Focus on updates that affect your specific industry or website type. E-commerce sites should prioritize product search updates, while publishers need to track news, Discover and helpful content changes. Monitor your rankings and traffic after announced updates—if you see movement, dive deeper into that particular change through expert analysis from trusted SEO publications.
